July 14, 2026

Strong brands know exactly who they serve best. For CoverGirl, that means reconnecting with a
generation that has been central to the brand's story for decades. Gen X accounts for roughly
one-third of beauty spending and is projected to remain the world's highest-spending generation
across consumer categories through at least 2033 — a consumer group with real purchasing power and a
clear appreciation for quality, accessibility, and value. Gordon von Bretten, President of Consumer
Beauty, put it plainly in Bloomberg Businessweek: "We're going to be intentional about serving that
consumer, rather than trying to be everything to everyone." That intentionality shows up in the work
— from campaigns featuring models aged 45 to 55 to sub-$10 innovation that keeps accessibility at
the core. Serving Gen X with greater focus, while remaining a brand for all generations, is what
powers CoverGirl's next chapter of growth. Read the full story in Bloomberg Businessweek:
https://lnkd.in/emFW-HNN #CotyNews #Coty #ConsumerBeauty #CoverGirl

unforgettable olfactive signature.   A new trio. A new era. Crafted in duality: the radiance of Pink

# Unilever Global

[Close ][66]

## Summary

A range of Unilever products being used, as well as advertising lifestyle imagery. Text throughout
the video reads: “Unilever is home to some of the world’s most iconic brands. We’re staying 1, 2, 3
steps ahead. Transforming into a Marketing & Sales machine. With SASSY brands creating Desire at
Scale.”

## Detailed description

The video begins with a close-up of a woman with curly hair adorned with gold bows smiling directly
into the camera. Her hands move toward the lens, briefly obscuring the view as she frames her face.
She wears a soft, light-toned top and has bright blue nail polish, creating a vibrant contrast
against her skin. The text “Unilever is home” appears, suggesting the start of a message about the
company. The frame pans out to show the woman is wearing an off-shoulder dress and standing in a
grand, ornate room. Several other people are visible in the background in a masked ball setting in
an elaborate regency-style room.

The next frame shows a close-up of a revolving jar of Dove 10-in-1 Serum Mask Intensive Repair. The
jar is white with a gold-coloured lid, and the background is silvery grey. The overlaid text sitting
to the left of the product, which reads “to some of the world’s”, continues the message from the
previous screen.

The scene cuts to a refrigerator interior shot. A bottle of Hellmann’s Spicy Mayonnaise stands
upright in the centre, surrounded by fresh ingredients such as tomatoes and red peppers. Bold blue
text, which reads “most iconic”, overlays the image.

The frame then switches to a close-up of a hand lifting a white piece of fabric in iridescent pastel
lighting, with soft-focus people in the background. The person’s reflection is visible on the sheet.
The words “and beloved” are overlaid, and the Vaseline logo appears in the top corner.

Next, the camera transitions to a Persil Wonder Wash detergent bottle, angled dynamically with water
droplets against a clean, blue-toned background. The word “brands” appears on screen.

The video then cuts to an overhead shot of a jar of smooth white cream. A hand with red nail polish
uses a small spatula to scoop some of the cream. The words “We’re staying” appear over the product.

The next frame shows a close-up of smooth gel-like cream in soft peach tones, with the number “1”
overlaid. This is followed by an abstract close-up of liquid bubbles on a blue background, with the
number “2” overlaid. And then a close-up of fresh lime slices against a white background, with the
number “3” overlaid. Next, the video zooms in on hands holding a small gold box against a light
background, casting a soft shadow. The words “steps ahead” appear over the box.

A close-up shot of fine red powder dispersing across a white background appears, creating a
textured, granular effect. The word “Transforming” appears over the image.

This is followed by a close-up of orange powder dispersing against a dark green background, with the
word “into” overlaid.

A new frame comes into view featuring three women standing shoulder to shoulder, smiling confidently
at the camera. They are diverse in appearance: one with short, curly hair; one with long, dark curly
hair; and one with straight, light brown hair. One woman has a visible arm tattoo. Overlaid text
reads: “a Marketing & Sales machine”.

The next frame shows a woman in a black beret and black-and-white striped jacket, wearing a red
necklace, eating cherries in a warm, soft-focus interior. The words “With SASSY brands” appear
beside her.

A stylised split-screen scene appears. Two women pose in elegant, black outfits within circular
frames. Both are holding a perfume bottle. The word “creating” repeats across the screen. The brand
name Nexxus appears at the bottom.

The screen focuses in on a woman with long, glossy dark hair and red lipstick, wearing a red coat
against a dark background with falling droplets. The word “Desire” is overlaid prominently.

This is followed by a close-up of two Nexxus bottles positioned diagonally against a black
background, partially visible at opposite corners, with the word “at” centred between them.

The next frame shows a Vaseline Gluta-Hya lip serum tube in cherry colour, positioned among large,
glossy red spheres against a light background. The word “Scale” appears prominently on the left.

Finally, the video switches into a soft, gradient background blending pastel shades of blue, purple
and pink. At the centre sits the Unilever logo, with the words “Desire at Scale”.

Across all the frames, the wording in its entirety reads: “Unilever is home to some of the world’s
most iconic brands. We’re staying 1, 2, 3 steps ahead. Transforming into a Marketing & Sales
machine. With SASSY brands creating Desire at Scale.”

No audio and no captions available

No more trade-offs. No more compromises. Just beauty and wellbeing as one.

Powering up Personal Care, developing superior products with breakthrough science and technology.

For the love of food – great taste is at the heart of everything we do.

[Close ][66]

## Summary

A range of Unilever products being used, as well as advertising lifestyle imagery. Text throughout
the video reads: “Unilever is home to some of the world’s most iconic brands. We’re staying 1, 2, 3
steps ahead. Transforming into a Marketing & Sales machine. With SASSY brands creating Desire at
Scale.”

## Detailed description

The video begins with a close-up of a woman with curly hair adorned with gold bows smiling directly
into the camera. Her hands move toward the lens, briefly obscuring the view as she frames her face.
She wears a soft, light-toned top and has bright blue nail polish, creating a vibrant contrast
against her skin. The text “Unilever is home” appears, suggesting the start of a message about the
company. The frame pans out to show the woman is wearing an off-shoulder dress and standing in a
grand, ornate room. Several other people are visible in the background in a masked ball setting in
an elaborate regency-style room.

The next frame shows a close-up of a revolving jar of Dove 10-in-1 Serum Mask Intensive Repair. The
jar is white with a gold-coloured lid, and the background is silvery grey. The overlaid text sitting
to the left of the product, which reads “to some of the world’s”, continues the message from the
previous screen.

The scene cuts to a refrigerator interior shot. A bottle of Hellmann’s Spicy Mayonnaise stands
upright in the centre, surrounded by fresh ingredients such as tomatoes and red peppers. Bold blue
text, which reads “most iconic”, overlays the image.

The frame then switches to a close-up of a hand lifting a white piece of fabric in iridescent pastel
lighting, with soft-focus people in the background. The person’s reflection is visible on the sheet.
The words “and beloved” are overlaid, and the Vaseline logo appears in the top corner.

Next, the camera transitions to a Persil Wonder Wash detergent bottle, angled dynamically with water
droplets against a clean, blue-toned background. The word “brands” appears on screen.

The video then cuts to an overhead shot of a jar of smooth white cream. A hand with red nail polish
uses a small spatula to scoop some of the cream. The words “We’re staying” appear over the product.

The next frame shows a close-up of smooth gel-like cream in soft peach tones, with the number “1”
overlaid. This is followed by an abstract close-up of liquid bubbles on a blue background, with the
number “2” overlaid. And then a close-up of fresh lime slices against a white background, with the
number “3” overlaid. Next, the video zooms in on hands holding a small gold box against a light
background, casting a soft shadow. The words “steps ahead” appear over the box.

A close-up shot of fine red powder dispersing across a white background appears, creating a
textured, granular effect. The word “Transforming” appears over the image.

This is followed by a close-up of orange powder dispersing against a dark green background, with the
word “into” overlaid.

A new frame comes into view featuring three women standing shoulder to shoulder, smiling confidently
at the camera. They are diverse in appearance: one with short, curly hair; one with long, dark curly
hair; and one with straight, light brown hair. One woman has a visible arm tattoo. Overlaid text
reads: “a Marketing & Sales machine”.

The next frame shows a woman in a black beret and black-and-white striped jacket, wearing a red
necklace, eating cherries in a warm, soft-focus interior. The words “With SASSY brands” appear
beside her.

A stylised split-screen scene appears. Two women pose in elegant, black outfits within circular
frames. Both are holding a perfume bottle. The word “creating” repeats across the screen. The brand
name Nexxus appears at the bottom.

The screen focuses in on a woman with long, glossy dark hair and red lipstick, wearing a red coat
against a dark background with falling droplets. The word “Desire” is overlaid prominently.

This is followed by a close-up of two Nexxus bottles positioned diagonally against a black
background, partially visible at opposite corners, with the word “at” centred between them.

The next frame shows a Vaseline Gluta-Hya lip serum tube in cherry colour, positioned among large,
glossy red spheres against a light background. The word “Scale” appears prominently on the left.

Finally, the video switches into a soft, gradient background blending pastel shades of blue, purple
and pink. At the centre sits the Unilever logo, with the words “Desire at Scale”.

Across all the frames, the wording in its entirety reads: “Unilever is home to some of the world’s
most iconic brands. We’re staying 1, 2, 3 steps ahead. Transforming into a Marketing & Sales
machine. With SASSY brands creating Desire at Scale.”

His verdict? Our biggest-ever sports activation puts creators at its centre, giving them experiences
that are too good not to post – a move that sparks authentic content and makes a global event feel
personal. Because scale is great. But scale without relevance is just expensive noise.

It's hard to find a good brow artist and she is it! She does such an awesome job every time!

[ FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS ][137]

How long does the sample production cycle for customized products take?

For color cosmetics and personal care products, samples are usually ready within 7-10 working days.
Skincare products, due to complex formula adjustments, take 10-15 working days. Perfume
customization, given the intricacy of fragrance blending, requires 12-18 working days.

How do you ensure the quality of customized products?

We adhere strictly to Good Manufacturing Practice for Cosmetics standards. All raw materials are
sourced from internationally certified suppliers, and each product batch undergoes microbiological
testing, stability testing, and allergy testing.

What is the delivery time for customized products?

For orders under 5,000 units, the delivery time for color cosmetics and personal care products is
approximately 20-25 days, while skincare and perfume products take about 25-30 days. For orders
exceeding 5,000 units, the delivery time will be extended by 5-10 days.

What is the pricing basis for customized products?

Pricing is based on raw material costs, packaging specifications, customization complexity, and
order quantity. Larger orders enjoy more favorable unit prices.

What is the minimum order quantity?

The minimum order quantity is 1,0000 units for color cosmetics and personal care products, 1,2000
units for skincare products, and 10000 bottles for perfume products.

[ FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS ][137]

How long does the sample production cycle for customized products take?

For color cosmetics and personal care products, samples are usually ready within 7-10 working days.
Skincare products, due to complex formula adjustments, take 10-15 working days. Perfume
customization, given the intricacy of fragrance blending, requires 12-18 working days.

How do you ensure the quality of customized products?

We adhere strictly to Good Manufacturing Practice for Cosmetics standards. All raw materials are
sourced from internationally certified suppliers, and each product batch undergoes microbiological
testing, stability testing, and allergy testing.

What is the delivery time for customized products?

For orders under 5,000 units, the delivery time for color cosmetics and personal care products is
approximately 20-25 days, while skincare and perfume products take about 25-30 days. For orders
exceeding 5,000 units, the delivery time will be extended by 5-10 days.

What is the pricing basis for customized products?

Pricing is based on raw material costs, packaging specifications, customization complexity, and
order quantity. Larger orders enjoy more favorable unit prices.

What is the minimum order quantity?

The minimum order quantity is 1,0000 units for color cosmetics and personal care products, 1,2000
units for skincare products, and 10000 bottles for perfume products.

## Eine Mission. Drei Marken. Beauty für alle.

[MAKE BEAUTY FUN logo]

## MAKE BEAUTY FUN

Seit 2002 begeistern wir Konsument:innen mit Beauty, die Spaß macht mit Top-Qualität zu
Lieblingspreisen. Heute sind wir eine globale Love Brand in über 90 Ländern und die meistverkaufte
Kosmetikmarke Europas.

100 % vegan, tierversuchsfrei (gemäß EU-Recht), verantwortungsbewusst und zukunftsorientiert.

[ Erfahre mehr über essence][11]
[Premium Beauty for everyone! logo]

## Premium Beauty for everyone!

Seit 2004 und mittlerweile in mehr als 70 Ländern weltweit präsent, ist es unsere Mission mit
Catrice, Premium-Beauty zu demokratisieren, damit alle Beauty Lover ihre Magic leben können: Von
Full Glam bis All Natural begeistert Catrice mit innovativen, hochwertigen Produktkonzepten,
Skincare-basierten Makeup Formeln und On-Trend Looks am Beauty Puls der Zeit.

[ Erfahre mehr über Catrice][12]
[Wellbeing meets Performance logo]

## Wellbeing meets Performance

Bei INAO möchten wir die innere und äußere Schönheit jedes Einzelnen betonen.

Unsere Schönheitsphilosophie teilen wir mit essence: authentisch sein, sich frei entfalten und
Freude erleben. Deshalb entwickeln wir Beauty- und Wohlfühlprodukte, die deine Stimmung heben und
dein Strahlen von innen nach außen unterstützen. Mit effektiven, worry-free Formulierungen machen
wir Wohlbefinden für alle zugänglich und bieten hochwertige Hautpflege sowie wirkungsvolle
Supplements.

[ Erfahre mehr über INAO][13]

## Unsere Zahlen sprechen für sich. Unsere Haltung auch.

### Loved around the globe

In über 90 Ländern sind Menschen in unsere Marken verliebt.

### VIDEO

### It won't cost the earth

Wir leben Nachhaltigkeit. Unsere Marken sind 100% vegan, tierversuchsfrei (gemäß EU-Recht) und auf
Kurs für Clean Beauty.

### We are where the consumer is

Digital & Social first. So sind wir im engen Dialog mit unserer Community - für Inspiration und
Transformation.

### People make the difference

Wo auch immer in 8 Standorten in der Welt unsere 1000 Kollegen gerade sind, wir sind ein Team,
gemeinsam mit Herz und Haltung.

### We love product

Wir sind total produktverliebt. Pro-Qualität, pro-Trend – schnell umgesetzt. Jährlich erneuern wir
40% unseres Standardsortiments. Cosmetics immer wieder neu.

Seit 2004 und mittlerweile in mehr als 70 Ländern weltweit präsent, ist es unsere Mission mit

Bei INAO möchten wir die innere und äußere Schönheit jedes Einzelnen betonen.

Unsere Schönheitsphilosophie teilen wir mit essence: authentisch sein, sich frei entfalten und
Freude erleben. Deshalb entwickeln wir Beauty- und Wohlfühlprodukte, die deine Stimmung heben und
dein Strahlen von innen nach außen unterstützen. Mit effektiven, worry-free Formulierungen machen
wir Wohlbefinden für alle zugänglich und bieten hochwertige Hautpflege sowie wirkungsvolle
Supplements.

Digital & Social first. So sind wir im engen Dialog mit unserer Community - für Inspiration und
Transformation.

# Free Online Games at CrazyGames

CrazyGames features the latest and best free online games. You can enjoy playing fun games without
interruptions from downloads, intrusive ads, or pop-ups. Just load up your favorite games instantly
in your web browser and enjoy the experience.

You can play our games on desktop and mobile devices. That includes everything from desktop PCs,
laptops, and Chromebooks, to the latest smartphones and tablets from Apple and Android. You can also
install CrazyGames as a mobile app, both on [Android][66] and on [iOS][67].

## About CrazyGames

There are plenty of online multiplayer games with active communities on CrazyGames. You can find
many of the best free multiplayer titles on our[ .io games ][68]page. In these games, you can play
with your friends online and with other people from around the world, no matter where you are.

## Play our Best Games

CrazyGames has over 4,500 fun games in every genre you can imagine. Some of our most popular games
are:
* [Shell Shockers][69]
* [Agar io][70]
* [Uno Online][71]
* [Geometry Dash][72]
* [Moto X3M][73]
* [Smash Karts][74]
* [GeoGuessr][75]
* [Hangman][76]

## Explore by Genre

You’ll find the main categories like [clicker][77], [driving games][78], and [shooting games][79] at
the top of any page, but there’s also a range of subcategories that will help you find the perfect
game. Popular tags include [car games][80], [Minecraft][81], [2-player games][82], [match 3
games][83], and [mahjong.][84]

## Suggest a Game

Is there a game that you love, but you can't find on CrazyGames? [Suggest a game][85] to us, and
we'll see what we can do to get it. You can also [contact us][86] for any general suggestions or
improvements.

## About CrazyGames

CrazyGames is a free browser gaming platform founded in 2014 by Raf Mertens. Since then, the
platform has grown to over 30 million monthly users.

Our mission is simple: to create a browser-gaming platform that works seamlessly for users around
the world and rewards developers both big and small. Visit our corporate site and learn more [about
CrazyGames][87].

DERMASPACE is a results-driven skincare studio specializing in the exclusive [iDerm Deep Ionization
Facial][40] - often called the "Skin Gym Facial" and available only at DERMASPACE in the Pacific
Northwest.

Think of it as physical therapy for your skin. Designed to deeply cleanse, calm inflammation,
support healing, and promote healthy aging, the iDerm Facial helps your skin function at its best.

Treatments can be customized with advanced enhancements including [LED Therapy][41],
[Dermaplaning][42], and [Microdermabrasion][43] to name a few.

In addition to our signature iDerm treatment, we offer [Oxygen Infusion Facial][44], [PCA Chemical
Peels][45], [BioRePeel][46], [Microneedling][47], and [ProCell Microchanneling.][48]

#### Our goal is simple: clean, heal, and maintain healthy skin.

Our Story

## A haven of *elegance* and self-care in the heart of Dubai.

Fema Beauty Salon is dedicated to enhancing your natural charm with personalized services and
professional expertise. We offer a complete range of hair, nail, skincare and grooming treatments
designed to make every client feel confident, refreshed and beautifully transformed.

Our skilled team uses high-quality products, modern techniques and a gentle touch to deliver
flawless results — whether you're here for a luxurious nail care session, rejuvenating facial or
precision brow work. Step into Fema, where beauty, comfort and care come together perfectly.

## How We Make The Finest
## Service Reviews

Singapore’s Finest Services has a team of anonymous reviewers who go around Singapore to try and
test all kinds of services and share their first-hand experiences. Along with their evaluation, we
also consider the reviews shared by the public on various forums to take a final decision. This
process helps us curate a list of only the finest services companies in Singapore.
Market Research
Our team conducts regular market surveys to identify the finest companies within each service
industry.
Selecting Services
We select the companies based on their online presence and reputation. We carefully review their
website, social media profiles, and also google reviews.
Company Listing
We list the company details on our website along with our assessment.
Post Reviews
We encourage companies to post these customer reviews on their company page to earn customer’s
trust.

* **Showcase**

## Face your skin.

With 30-minute expert facials by licensed estheticians who get your skin, say goodbye to guesswork.

[ BOOK NOW ][49]

## Customized for you.

We all have skincare concerns; it's not always 'simple.' Glowbar makes it easy with custom 30-minute
expert facials, targeting your needs in real-time. 

**Don't wish for great skin, get it. **

[ LEARN MORE ][50]

WE ARE

Targeted treatments, not spa facials
30 minutes, not over an hour
One flat price, no add-ons
Real results, not quick fixes
Skincare experts, not false promises
$65 for Members

Consistently great skin needs consistently great care. As a Glowbar member, you’ll receive monthly
facial treatments, plus special pricing on professional-grade products. Your skin will thank you.

[ BECOME A MEMBER ][51]
$85 for Non-Members

Not ready to commit to the membership? NBD! Non-member treatments are $85, with no add-ons ever.

[ BOOK AN APPOINTMENT ][52]

## Find a Glowbar near you

Ready to get your glow on? Find your nearest Glowbar studio and book your 30-minute, customized
facial. 

[ STUDIO FINDER ][53]

## New Studios Coming Soon
* Westfield
  
  118 Elm St, Westfield, NJ 07090
  
  [ BECOME A FOUNDING MEMBER ][54]

  94 Central St, Wellesley, MA 02482
  
  [ JOIN THE WAITLIST ][55]

  1704 Frankford Avenue, Philadelphia, PA 19125
  
  [ BECOME A FOUNDING MEMBER ][56]
* Forest Hills
  
  70-40 Austin St, Forest Hills, NY 11375
  
  [ JOIN THE WAITLIST ][57]

## No Glowbar Studio Near You?

get the glow delivered right to your door

Our expert estheticians have delivered over three quarters of a million facials across 25 studios,
and we bottled that expertise so it can be available at your bathroom counter. Shop our [Expert
Cleanser,][58] [Simple Solution][59], and [Spot Service][60] formulated to make an easy, effective
routine accessible to everyone.

[ EXPLORE OUR PRODUCTS ][61]

## Our skin in the game

“opting for a monthly facial is a way to keep your skin in tip-top shape and try some new products
along the way.”

— CNN

“Glowbar is your answer to jam-packed months where you feel like you have no time for self-care.”

— HYPEBAE

“For the beauty guru on the go, there’s no better choice than Glowbar…”

— GOTHAM

“Whether you're looking for a weekend moment of self care, or a quick step-away-from-the-office
reset, Glowbar is your go-to spot for a no nonsense, luxe facial that will have you in, out and
looking beyond your best in just 30 minutes.”

— GUEST OF A GUEST

“Glowbar is making waves in the facial game.”

— FASHION WEEK ONLINE

“It’s quite honestly the best thing for your skin…”

— COVETEUR

## But don't just take our word for it

> “So thrilled Glowbar is in my neighborhood. I have loved my services…always so thoughtful and
> targeted, my skin has never looked better. Everyone who works here is so friendly it's always a
> lovely experience. Trust me, GO!!”
> 
> Alyssa Bronander

> “I love Glowbar! The whole experience is 10/10! The staff is so nice and the studio is very clean
> and calming. The estheticians are great and walk you through the whole process and are very
> informative. Definitely recommend!”
> 
> Shania Acevedo

> “Skincare is all about consistency, and that’s been my whole priority since I started with
> Glowbar. I didn’t know how to take care of my skin. However, with Glowbar I learned everything
> step by step to have my skin the healthiest it’s been.”
> 
> Rudy Taveras

## Share your #afterglowbar glow

**@glowbar**

Advanced lasers, natural injectables, and medical-grade treatments including facials, microneedling,
and body contouring, all designed to help men and women achieve healthy skin, natural results, and
whole-body vitality.

# Award-Winning, Physician-Led Aesthetics


Advanced lasers, natural injectables, and medical-grade treatments including facials, microneedling,
and body contouring, all designed to help men and women achieve healthy skin, natural results, and
whole-body vitality.

[Book a Consultation][49]

## GlowFit: Results That Go Deeper Than Skin.

Our physician-led program combines personalized medical care with proven weight management therapies
to help restore balance, build confidence, and achieve results designed to last.

Accepting a limited number of new patients.

[ Learn more about our services ][50] [ Learn more about our services ][51]
[Image]

## Introducing GlowBalance

A physician-led approach to hormone optimization and whole-body wellness designed to address
fatigue, mood changes, weight gain, sleep disruption, and more through comprehensive testing and
ongoing, personalized care.

Because this isn’t a one-time prescription.
It’s care that evolves with you.

[ Discover Hormone Wellness ][52] [ Discover Hormone Wellness ][53]

Where advanced aesthetics meet expert care, with every treatment personalized, physician-led, and
designed to deliver natural, beautiful results.

Smooth lines. Natural movement.

Brighten. Smooth. Restore.

[Explore Treatment][55]

Tone. Strengthen. Sculpt.

[Explore Treatment][56]

### collagen renewal

Microneedling treatments for healthy skin.

[Explore Treatment][57]

We strive to create a peaceful, relaxing environment so you can be completely at ease during your
appointment. At your initial consultation, we’ll do a thorough evaluation of your skin and ask you
lots of questions. We want to get to know you and understand your priorities as part of developing
your personal treatment plan.

Whether you’re looking to reduce any visible signs of aging, correct imperfections, or just enhance
your natural appearance, we can help.

After a few years of trying to find a medical spa/doctor I truly love, I finally found it here.
Highly recommend!!!

-- LK - West Seattle

## Wholesale FAQs

Got questions? We've got answers.

1. What is the minimum order requirement?

Our minimum order is $250, with mix-and-match across categories. Fast-Ship (CA in-stock) items have
no per-product MOQ, making it easy to test new products without large commitments. For
overseas-fulfilled items, wholesale pricing may require meeting the listed MOQ/case pack. Mix and
match across Korean skincare, Korean makeup/cosmetics, and fragrances to build a balanced
assortment.

2. How long does shipping take?

Shipping timelines vary by product availability. In-stock items ship from the U.S. and typically
deliver within 3–5 business days after fulfillment. Standard lead-time items are generally about 3–5
weeks. We show product-level lead times on each product page so retailers can plan reorders and
restocks.

3. Are all products 100% authentic?

Yes. We prioritize 100% authentic inventory through verified sourcing from vetted distributor and
brand-partner channels. Where available, we also document practical indicators such as batch/lot
codes, expiration dates, and packaging details to support retailer recordkeeping and customer
support.

4. Who can apply for a wholesale account?

We work with qualified retailers including boutiques, salons/spas, online retailers, and other
U.S.-based businesses selling beauty products. We review applications quickly and approve catalog
access for qualified accounts. You’ll typically need basic business details such as a business
license and/or EIN/Tax ID.

5. Do you provide invoices/proof of purchase for retailers?

Yes. We provide order documentation/invoices suitable for retailer recordkeeping. If you need
specific paperwork for marketplace or compliance requirements (for example, proof of purchase for
platform verification), tell us what you need and we’ll help confirm what’s available for your
order.

6. Why aren’t your prices the cheapest?

We focus on verified sourcing and authentic inventory, not gray-market pricing. Many items are
purchased through vetted distributor and brand-partner channels, with documentation/invoices
available for retailer recordkeeping. That sourcing standard—along with clear product-level lead
times and U.S.-based support—is why pricing may differ from “lowest price” listings.

## Wholesale FAQs

Got questions? We've got answers.

1. What is the minimum order requirement?

Our minimum order is $250, with mix-and-match across categories. Fast-Ship (CA in-stock) items have
no per-product MOQ, making it easy to test new products without large commitments. For
overseas-fulfilled items, wholesale pricing may require meeting the listed MOQ/case pack. Mix and
match across Korean skincare, Korean makeup/cosmetics, and fragrances to build a balanced
assortment.

2. How long does shipping take?

Shipping timelines vary by product availability. In-stock items ship from the U.S. and typically
deliver within 3–5 business days after fulfillment. Standard lead-time items are generally about 3–5
weeks. We show product-level lead times on each product page so retailers can plan reorders and
restocks.

Yes. We prioritize 100% authentic inventory through verified sourcing from vetted distributor and
brand-partner channels. Where available, we also document practical indicators such as batch/lot
codes, expiration dates, and packaging details to support retailer recordkeeping and customer
support.

4. Who can apply for a wholesale account?

We work with qualified retailers including boutiques, salons/spas, online retailers, and other
U.S.-based businesses selling beauty products. We review applications quickly and approve catalog
access for qualified accounts. You’ll typically need basic business details such as a business
license and/or EIN/Tax ID.

5. Do you provide invoices/proof of purchase for retailers?

Yes. We provide order documentation/invoices suitable for retailer recordkeeping. If you need
specific paperwork for marketplace or compliance requirements (for example, proof of purchase for
platform verification), tell us what you need and we’ll help confirm what’s available for your
order.

6. Why aren’t your prices the cheapest?

purchased through vetted distributor and brand-partner channels, with documentation/invoices
available for retailer recordkeeping. That sourcing standard—along with clear product-level lead
times and U.S.-based support—is why pricing may differ from “lowest price” listings.

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

From cutting-edge technology campuses to architecturally stunning corporate offices, these
headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to
office layout, sustainability, wellness, and creativity, making them a powerful source of
inspiration for corporate office management teams and business leaders worldwide.

To explore these incredible headquarters in action and see what makes them stand out, watch the

If you have ever wondered what it would be like to work in a truly inspiring corporate environment,
these headquarters represent the ultimate vision of modern office life. They are not just
offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters
across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

## Enhance Your Natural Beauty with Personalized Med Spa Treatments at Inject Beauty

Do you feel like your skin could use a little refresh? Maybe a med spa trip could help. At Inject
Beauty in West Monroe, Louisiana, we specialize in helping you achieve a natural, youthful glow
through a range of bespoke aesthetic treatments.

## More Than Just Skincare:

We understand that beauty is more than skin deep. That’s why at our med spa we take a personalized
approach to every client. We’ll work with you during your initial consultation to understand your
unique goals and concerns. Whether you’re looking to:
* Minimize sun damage and signs of aging
* Restore a youthful appearance
* Enhance your natural features

We’ll develop a treatment plan tailored specifically for you.

## Our Menu of Med Spa Services:

We offer a variety of advanced aesthetic treatments to address a wide range of concerns. Some of our
most popular med spa treatment options include:
* **Microneedling: **This minimally invasive treatment stimulates collagen production, improving
  skin texture and reducing fine lines.
* **RF Microneedling: **Combining microneedling with radiofrequency energy for deeper rejuvenation
  with InMode Morpheus8 Face.
* **IPL Photofacial: **Utilizing intense pulsed light technology to target sun damage and
  hyperpigmentation.
* **Neurotoxins: **We currently offer Botox®, Dysport®, and Daxxify®. These injectable treatments
  relax muscles that contribute to wrinkles and fine lines, providing a smoother, more youthful
  appearance.
* **Laser Hair Removal: **Experience permanent hair reduction with InMode DiolazeXL, a revolutionary
  laser hair removal treatment.

###### HOW IT WORKS

### GUARANTEEING YOU A SAFE & COMFORTABLE MEDSPA EXPERIENCE

Inject Beauty is a top MedSpa in Monroe, LA, specializing in advanced non-surgical aesthetic
techniques with a personalized touch. Understanding the complexities of these procedures, we do not
rush you into a decision. Our aestheticians will take the time to listen and understand your needs,
devising a treatment plan that celebrates your unique features.

All the procedures are performed amidst the calming ambiance** **of our MedSpa in Monroe, LA, and by
trained practitioners to achieve the best possible outcomes. We educate our patients about the
entire process, safety precautions, and risk factors. This gives them the confidence of informed
decisions that result beyond cookie-cutter beauty unlocking your confidence from within.

### The Inject Beauty Difference:

We believe true beauty comes from feeling confident and comfortable in your skin. At Inject Beauty,
a West Monroe, Louisiana med spa, you’ll experience:
* **A Warm and Welcoming Environment: **Our experienced and professional med spa staff will make you
  feel relaxed and comfortable throughout your entire visit.
* **The Perfect Blend of Science and Art: **We combine cutting-edge technology with a deep
  understanding of aesthetics to achieve natural-looking results.
* **A Focus on Your Well-Being: **We believe that aesthetics can boost confidence and overall
  well-being.

### Ready to Look and Feel Your Best?

Contact Inject Beauty med spa today to schedule a consultation and learn more about how we can help
you achieve your aesthetic goals at our med spa. We look forward to helping you embrace your unique
beauty!

### Call to Action:

Book your consultation at Inject Beauty med spa today and let’s discuss how we can help you achieve
your natural beauty goals! Contact Inject Beauty today to schedule a consultation and experience the
med spa difference for yourself.

# UNLEASHING YOUR INNER GLOW

At Inject Beauty, we’re not in the business of cookie-cutter beauty. We celebrate your unique
features and confidently guide you to treatments that enhance your natural allure. Our approach is

###### WHO WE ARE?


## INJECT BEAUTY – BEST MEDSPA IN MONROE, LA

We’re the experts in medical aesthetics!! Our team is committed to advancing the field of minimally
invasive cosmetic procedures for over a decade. During this time, we’ve catered to the aesthetic
needs of over 10,000 patients with utmost meticulousness and satisfaction. Our volume of experience
as the best MedSpa in Monroe means that we possess a high level of proficiency that is truly second
to none.

From body treatments to injectables to skin and hair your path to beauty starts at Inject Beauty in
Monroe, LA. Top-quality, FDA-approved aesthetic products meet our high standards of care to deliver
the best MedSpa experience ever!!


## ENHANCE YOUR UNIQUE BEAUTY WITH OUR SERVICES

At Inject Beauty, we empower you to embrace your natural, youthful glow with a range of bespoke,
results-driven treatments. We offer a variety of treatments, all uniquely tailored to your needs.
From personalized [Microneedling][100] and [RF Microneedling][101] services that enhance skin
texture to our [IPL Photofacial][102] that minimizes sun damage, we have an array of options to
rejuvenate your skin.

Explore non-invasive skin tightening with our [Forma][103] treatments, or soften fine lines with our
selection of [Neurotoxins,][104] [Dermal Fillers][105], and [Sculptra Face][106] injections.  Opt
for silky, hair-free skin with our [Laser Hair Removal][107] service, or address excessive sweating
with effective [Hyperhidrosis treatments][108].

Experience the power of [PRF Therapy][109] using your body’s own platelet-rich fibrin, and indulge

Evolve X, and [Sculptra Body][112] offer a safe way to shape your body without surgery.

perfection. We believe in the power of aesthetics to boost confidence and well-being. We listen to
your concerns, tailor treatments to your individual needs, and are with you every step of the way –
even after your treatment – to ensure you love your results.

## Enhance Your Natural Beauty with Personalized Med Spa Treatments at Inject Beauty

Do you feel like your skin could use a little refresh? Maybe a med spa trip could help. At Inject
Beauty in West Monroe, Louisiana, we specialize in helping you achieve a natural, youthful glow
through a range of bespoke aesthetic treatments.

## More Than Just Skincare:

We understand that beauty is more than skin deep. That’s why at our med spa we take a personalized
approach to every client. We’ll work with you during your initial consultation to understand your
unique goals and concerns. Whether you’re looking to:
* Minimize sun damage and signs of aging
* Restore a youthful appearance
* Enhance your natural features

We’ll develop a treatment plan tailored specifically for you.

## Our Menu of Med Spa Services:

We offer a variety of advanced aesthetic treatments to address a wide range of concerns. Some of our
most popular med spa treatment options include:
* **Microneedling: **This minimally invasive treatment stimulates collagen production, improving
  skin texture and reducing fine lines.
* **RF Microneedling: **Combining microneedling with radiofrequency energy for deeper rejuvenation
  with InMode Morpheus8 Face.
* **IPL Photofacial: **Utilizing intense pulsed light technology to target sun damage and
  hyperpigmentation.
* **Neurotoxins: **We currently offer Botox®, Dysport®, and Daxxify®. These injectable treatments
  relax muscles that contribute to wrinkles and fine lines, providing a smoother, more youthful
  appearance.
* **Laser Hair Removal: **Experience permanent hair reduction with InMode DiolazeXL, a revolutionary
  laser hair removal treatment.

###### HOW IT WORKS

### GUARANTEEING YOU A SAFE & COMFORTABLE MEDSPA EXPERIENCE

All the procedures are performed amidst the calming ambiance** **of our MedSpa in Monroe, LA, and by

We believe true beauty comes from feeling confident and comfortable in your skin. At Inject Beauty,
a West Monroe, Louisiana med spa, you’ll experience:
* **A Warm and Welcoming Environment: **Our experienced and professional med spa staff will make you

* **The Perfect Blend of Science and Art: **We combine cutting-edge technology with a deep

* **A Focus on Your Well-Being: **We believe that aesthetics can boost confidence and overall
  well-being.

beauty!

### Soak it all in.

# Let it all hang out.

WOMEN’S DAY SPA • GREENWOOD • SEATTLE, WA • ALL GENDER WEDNESDAYS

### Welcome to The Ladies Room—your space to pause, breathe, and reconnect.

#### 
#### Nestled in the heart of Greenwood, The Ladies Room is more than a silent spa - it’s a sanctuary
#### designed for deep relaxation, renewal, and self-care as a ritual.

#### Woman-owned and operated, we are dedicated to nurturing a safe, inclusive space where you can
#### unwind, restore, and return to yourself.

#### 
#### As a silent spa, we invite you to step away from the noise of daily life and sink into
#### stillness. Whether you’re here for hydrotherapy, radiant skin, or simply a moment of pause,
#### we’re holding space for you.
* #### Tops optional, bathing suit bottoms required.
* #### All genders welcome on Wednesdays.
  
  #### Come inside, exhale, and let us take care of the rest.

### Hydrotherapy

Soak in good vibes and good company with a day pass to our warm and welcoming pools, saunas, steam
room and relaxation room. Silence is Golden.
* Soaking Pools
* Saunas
* Steam Room
* Relaxation Room

### Spà-la-Carte Services

Treat yourself—you deserve it! Select from our menu of custom spa services.

    deforestation, ESG

Cold Pressed Oils - jojoba oil, argan oil, rosehip oil and etc.

[photo]

Pure, natural extracts from plants, meticulously crafted by manufacturers for holistic wellness and
aromatic experiences.

[photo]

#### [Butter][120]

Premium cosmetic-grade butter, meticulously produced for skincare, by AG Organica. Elevate your
formulations with our high-quality and pure ingredients.

[photo]

#### [Spice Essential Oils][121]

Spice Oils are extracted generally by steam distillation process. They are commonly used in a huge
variety of cuisines for taste enhancement.

[photo]

#### [Pharmaceutical Grade Essential Oil][122]

Harness the age-old therapeutic benefits of essential oils derived from natural herbs and plants
with pharmaceutical and therapeutic potentials.

[photo]

#### [Floral Water][123]

Floral water, distilled from flowers, is used in skincare and aromatherapy. Facial toners added to
daily routines improve pores' appearance and tightness.

[photo]

#### [Fragrance][124]

Fragrance, a delightful scent, adds allure to personal care products, creating a lasting impression
and enhancing everyday experiences with pleasant aromas.

[photo]

#### [Face Serum][125]

Face serum boosts collagen in your skin, keeping it firm and plumping out fine lines and wrinkles.

[photo]

#### [Facial Cleansers][126]

A facial cleanser is crafted to cleanse, hydrate, and soothe your skin. It will have a creamy,
milky, gel-like, or even watery texture.

[photo]

#### [Face Wash][127]

A skincare product that removes make-up, dead skin cells, oil, dirt, and other pollutants from the
skin thereby keeping pores clear and preventing skin conditions like acne.

[photo]

#### [Face Oil][128]

Face oils are intended to moisturize and hydrate the skin, and are typically formulated with a blend
of plant oils to soften, nourish, and balance the skin for a healthy-looking glow.

[photo]

#### [Face Cream][129]

It retains moisture and elasticity in your skin, which can aid in the reduction of wrinkles, age
spots, and other fine lines.

[photo]

#### [Face Mists][130]

With ingredients like vitamins, extracts, and essential oils, face mists provide an instant hit of
hydration.

[photo]

#### [Face Scrub][131]

Facial scrubs thoroughly exfoliate your skin and remove dead skin cells, leaving it clean and fresh.

[photo]

#### [Face Mask][132]

Facial masks refine pores, reduce fine lines, even out skin tone, improve hydration, and make your
skin look firmer and younger.

[photo]

#### [Face Toner][133]

Face toners have a positive impact on the appearance and tightness of your pores when added to your
daily skincare routine.

[photo]

#### [Face Lotion][134]

A face lotion contains emollients, which keep the skin hydrated. They seal the skin, keeping
moisture and nutrients in while protecting it from environmental toxicants.

[photo]

#### Hair Serum

Hair serum is a liquid-based treatment that is typically designed to provide a protective layer over
the hair fiber, thereby assisting in the smoothing of frizz.

[photo]

#### Hair Cleansers

Hair wax is a styling product that is generally sticky with a clay-and-paste-like consistency that
works well to add texture to various hairstyles.

[photo]

#### Shampoo

Shampoo's primary function is to remove dirt and oil from the surface of hair fibers and the scalp.

[photo]

#### Ayurvedic Hair Oil

Ayurvedic hair oil is a type of herbal oil that is created by combining carrier oil with ayurvedic
botanical extracts.

[photo]

#### Anti-Dandruff Lotion

Anti-Dandruff Lotion is a highly effective formula that combines dandruff controlling activities to
prevent the formation of dandruff scales.

[photo]

#### Medicine Hair Oil

It is a comprehensive solution for hair-related issues, particularly hair fall control and hair
growth.

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

Translate insight into prioritised initiatives, investments and go to market plays.

### Revenue Impact

Execute with confidence and measure the effect on growth, margin and resilience.

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

## NYC facial questions, answered

What is TheNewYorkFacial.com?
TheNewYorkFacial.com is a curated directory of spas, salons, facial clinics, and beauty businesses
across all five NYC boroughs. We help New Yorkers find trusted, locally vetted service providers and
visit their websites directly to book appointments.
How much does a facial cost in New York City in 2025-2026?
NYC facial prices are 20-40% higher than the national average due to premium overhead. Basic facials
start at $100-$175, HydraFacials run $200-$400, and luxury treatments at top Manhattan med spas
(SoHo, Upper East Side, Midtown) can reach $500-$900 per session. Brooklyn and Queens clinics tend
to offer comparable quality at 15-25% lower prices.
What are the most popular facial treatments in NYC right now?
In 2025-2026, the most booked treatments at NYC clinics are HydraFacials, microneedling with PRP
(the 'vampire facial'), and LED light therapy combos. The 'Glass Skin Facial' trending in Manhattan
med spas costs $600-$900 and combines chemical exfoliation, hyaluronic acid infusion, and LED to
achieve the dewy K-beauty look.
Where are the best neighborhoods in NYC to get a facial?
Manhattan's SoHo, Flatiron, and Upper East Side are home to the highest concentration of luxury
facial clinics and celebrity estheticians. Williamsburg and Park Slope in Brooklyn offer excellent
boutique studios at more accessible price points. Astoria and Flushing in Queens have standout spots
specializing in K-beauty and holistic facials.
How often should I get a facial living in New York City?
NYC dermatologists recommend facials every 4-6 weeks, but city living may warrant more frequent
visits. Pollution, subway air, and seasonal extremes (humid summers, dry heated winters) accelerate
skin congestion and dehydration. Many NYC estheticians suggest adding a monthly hydrating or detox
facial on top of your regular routine during winter months.
What facial is best for acne caused by NYC pollution and stress?
NYC estheticians frequently recommend a combination of blue LED therapy and salicylic acid peels
($175-$350) for pollution-triggered breakouts. Oxygen facials ($150-$250) are also popular in the
city for detoxifying congested pores. A series of 4-6 bi-weekly sessions is typical for clearing
stress and environmental acne.
What are the 2026 facial trends in New York City?
NYC is leading the 'quiet luxury' skincare trend for 2026, with med spas focusing on regenerative
treatments using exosomes and growth factors instead of heavy filler. AI-powered skin diagnostics
are now standard at top Manhattan clinics, and preventative 'baby Botox' combined with
collagen-stimulating facials is surging among NYC clients in their late 20s and early 30s.
Are there good facials in NYC for sensitive or rosacea-prone skin?
Yes, many NYC clinics specialize in sensitive skin protocols. Enzyme peels, cryotherapy facials, and
gentle oxygen treatments are widely available across all boroughs. Top providers in Manhattan and
Brooklyn use AI skin analysis to customize ingredient concentrations, and many offer patch testing
48 hours before your first session at no extra charge.
What should I expect at my first facial appointment in NYC?
A first-time facial in NYC typically lasts 60-90 minutes and includes a skin consultation, double
cleanse, professional exfoliation, extractions (if needed), a treatment mask, and SPF application.
Most clinics send intake forms digitally beforehand. Expect mild redness for 2-6 hours after and
avoid the subway or heavy makeup immediately following your session.
What is the difference between a med spa facial and a day spa facial in NYC?
NYC day spas offer relaxation-focused facials ($100-$250) with gentle products and massage, while
med spas provide clinical-grade treatments ($200-$800) supervised by dermatologists or nurse
practitioners. Med spas can use stronger acids, prescription retinoids, microneedling devices, and
injectables that day spas legally cannot. Choose based on whether your goal is pampering or targeted
skin correction.
Do NYC facial clinics offer membership or package deals?
Yes, most NYC facial studios offer monthly memberships ($150-$350/month for one treatment) and
prepaid packages of 4-6 sessions at 15-25% off individual pricing. Some Manhattan med spas also
offer annual VIP programs that include priority booking, complimentary add-ons like LED or
dermaplaning, and exclusive access to new treatments.
What pre-care and post-care should I follow for a facial in NYC?
Before your appointment, avoid retinoids and exfoliating acids for 48-72 hours, skip tanning, and
arrive with a clean face. After treatment, apply SPF 30+ before heading outside (NYC UV exposure is
significant even on cloudy days), avoid heavy makeup for 12 hours, skip intense workouts and hot
yoga for 24 hours, and keep skin hydrated with a gentle moisturizer.

## NYC facial questions, answered

What is TheNewYorkFacial.com?
TheNewYorkFacial.com is a curated directory of spas, salons, facial clinics, and beauty businesses
across all five NYC boroughs. We help New Yorkers find trusted, locally vetted service providers and
visit their websites directly to book appointments.
How much does a facial cost in New York City in 2025-2026?
NYC facial prices are 20-40% higher than the national average due to premium overhead. Basic facials
start at $100-$175, HydraFacials run $200-$400, and luxury treatments at top Manhattan med spas
(SoHo, Upper East Side, Midtown) can reach $500-$900 per session. Brooklyn and Queens clinics tend
to offer comparable quality at 15-25% lower prices.
What are the most popular facial treatments in NYC right now?
In 2025-2026, the most booked treatments at NYC clinics are HydraFacials, microneedling with PRP
(the 'vampire facial'), and LED light therapy combos. The 'Glass Skin Facial' trending in Manhattan
med spas costs $600-$900 and combines chemical exfoliation, hyaluronic acid infusion, and LED to
achieve the dewy K-beauty look.
Where are the best neighborhoods in NYC to get a facial?
Manhattan's SoHo, Flatiron, and Upper East Side are home to the highest concentration of luxury
facial clinics and celebrity estheticians. Williamsburg and Park Slope in Brooklyn offer excellent
boutique studios at more accessible price points. Astoria and Flushing in Queens have standout spots
specializing in K-beauty and holistic facials.
How often should I get a facial living in New York City?
NYC dermatologists recommend facials every 4-6 weeks, but city living may warrant more frequent
visits. Pollution, subway air, and seasonal extremes (humid summers, dry heated winters) accelerate
skin congestion and dehydration. Many NYC estheticians suggest adding a monthly hydrating or detox
facial on top of your regular routine during winter months.
What facial is best for acne caused by NYC pollution and stress?
NYC estheticians frequently recommend a combination of blue LED therapy and salicylic acid peels
($175-$350) for pollution-triggered breakouts. Oxygen facials ($150-$250) are also popular in the
city for detoxifying congested pores. A series of 4-6 bi-weekly sessions is typical for clearing
stress and environmental acne.
What are the 2026 facial trends in New York City?
NYC is leading the 'quiet luxury' skincare trend for 2026, with med spas focusing on regenerative
treatments using exosomes and growth factors instead of heavy filler. AI-powered skin diagnostics
are now standard at top Manhattan clinics, and preventative 'baby Botox' combined with
collagen-stimulating facials is surging among NYC clients in their late 20s and early 30s.
Are there good facials in NYC for sensitive or rosacea-prone skin?
Yes, many NYC clinics specialize in sensitive skin protocols. Enzyme peels, cryotherapy facials, and
gentle oxygen treatments are widely available across all boroughs. Top providers in Manhattan and
Brooklyn use AI skin analysis to customize ingredient concentrations, and many offer patch testing
48 hours before your first session at no extra charge.
What should I expect at my first facial appointment in NYC?
A first-time facial in NYC typically lasts 60-90 minutes and includes a skin consultation, double
cleanse, professional exfoliation, extractions (if needed), a treatment mask, and SPF application.
Most clinics send intake forms digitally beforehand. Expect mild redness for 2-6 hours after and
avoid the subway or heavy makeup immediately following your session.
What is the difference between a med spa facial and a day spa facial in NYC?
NYC day spas offer relaxation-focused facials ($100-$250) with gentle products and massage, while
med spas provide clinical-grade treatments ($200-$800) supervised by dermatologists or nurse
practitioners. Med spas can use stronger acids, prescription retinoids, microneedling devices, and
injectables that day spas legally cannot. Choose based on whether your goal is pampering or targeted
skin correction.
Do NYC facial clinics offer membership or package deals?
Yes, most NYC facial studios offer monthly memberships ($150-$350/month for one treatment) and
prepaid packages of 4-6 sessions at 15-25% off individual pricing. Some Manhattan med spas also
offer annual VIP programs that include priority booking, complimentary add-ons like LED or
dermaplaning, and exclusive access to new treatments.
What pre-care and post-care should I follow for a facial in NYC?
Before your appointment, avoid retinoids and exfoliating acids for 48-72 hours, skip tanning, and
arrive with a clean face. After treatment, apply SPF 30+ before heading outside (NYC UV exposure is
significant even on cloudy days), avoid heavy makeup for 12 hours, skip intense workouts and hot
yoga for 24 hours, and keep skin hydrated with a gentle moisturizer.

links directly to the business's own website.
